ivo: the RCS for human can be modelled as the log-normal distribution with the mean value corresponding to the component , mathematically formulated as Eq. 3 The standard deviation corresponding to the component can be defined by the average value of measured results, where Eq. 4 Ericsson: Parameterize the bistatic radar cross-section by listing the coefficients of their spherical harmonic expansion. AT&T Proposal 12: For bi-static TRP-UE sensing, RCS for a passenger car and a pedestrian can be modeled as a log-normal distribution with the following mean and standard deviations. Based on the contributions, most companies observe that bistatic RCS cannot be accurately derived by monostatic RCS if the bistatic angle is relatively large. Therefore, the moderator makes the following proposal. Bistatic RCS values/patterns for a scattering point of a target are to be obtained by measurement or ray-tracing
